name: pulse
description: A free, open audience response platform.

scripts.dev: npm run theme:build && concurrently -n server,client,join -c green,magenta,cyan -k "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client" "npm:dev:join"
scripts.build: npm run theme:build && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.theme:build: npm run build -w shared && node scripts/build-theme.mjs
scripts.dev:client:only: npm run theme:build && npm run dev -w client
